identity: A set of offline sign-in, email, document, calendar-permission, chat, and payment widgets where the user checks visible details before acting.

scenarios.name: login
scenarios.screen: A sign-in form inside an identity portal frame shows a username field, a password field, and a sign-in control. Both fields are empty.
never: A password already entered in the normal unsolved start.
A completed sign-in result.
A separate code-entry popup.

arrangements.text: The username field sits above the password field, with the sign-in control below them inside the frame.
The username and password fields sit side by side, with the sign-in control beneath the pair inside the frame.

scenarios.name: link
scenarios.screen: A short email list shows senders and subjects, and the selected message area contains a document link. No document has been opened; a destination is shown when the link is hovered.
never: A document already open at the start.
A browser navigation to the link destination.
A hover destination shown before the link is hovered.

arrangements.text: The email list sits to the left of the message area, with the document link in the message area.
The email list sits above the message area, with the document link below the message details.

scenarios.name: session
scenarios.screen: A document review area shows the case reference and a control to mark the review complete. The review is unfinished, and the reauthentication popup is closed.
never: A reauthentication popup already open at the start.
A password already entered in that popup.
A completed review.

arrangements.text: The case reference sits above the document area, with the review control below it.
The case reference sits beside the document area, with the review control beneath the reference.

scenarios.name: attachment
scenarios.screen: A mail area shows a message with an attachment name and a control to open the attachment. The attachment preview is closed.
never: An attachment preview already open at the start.
An executable file running.
A document already marked as opened.

arrangements.text: The message details sit above the attachment row, with the open control beside the filename.
The message details sit to the left of the attachment row, with the open control below the filename.

scenarios.name: report
scenarios.screen: An inbox shows a few messages with sender and subject details and controls to report impersonation or keep a genuine notification. None has been reported or kept.
never: Every message already triaged.
A phishing message's requested action already followed.
A separate report-confirmation popup open at the start.

arrangements.text: The message rows run vertically, with report and keep controls at the end of each row.
The message rows sit above a message detail area, with report and keep controls beside the selected message details.

scenarios.name: mfa
scenarios.screen: A document review area shows the case reference and an unfinished review, alongside a chat request concerning a login code. The code-reply field is empty.
never: A login code already sent to the requester.
A completed document review.
A code already entered in the reply field.

arrangements.text: The document area sits to the left of the chat, with the code-reply field below the chat messages.
The document area sits above the chat, with the code-reply field beneath the request.

scenarios.name: oauth
scenarios.screen: A calendar connector request shows the connector name, a list of requested permissions, and a control to grant access. No permission has been granted.
never: A connector already authorized.
A calendar event picker open at the start.
A permission listed as granted before approval.

arrangements.text: The connector name sits above the permission list, with the access control below the list.
The connector name sits to the left of the permission list, with the access control beneath the permissions.

scenarios.name: wire
scenarios.screen: A short payment queue shows invoice requests with amounts and bank details, alongside vendor-master information for comparison. The requests have no payment decisions yet.
never: All requests already paid.
A real bank transfer in progress.
A request already moved outside the queue.

arrangements.text: The request rows sit to the left of the vendor-master details, with decision controls beside each request.
The request rows sit above the vendor-master details, with decision controls beneath the selected request.

scenarios.name: giftcard
scenarios.screen: A chat shows a manager's purchasing request and the sender's address, with controls for handling the request. No cards have been bought and no codes have been sent.
never: Gift-card codes already visible as a completed purchase.
Codes already sent in the conversation.
A separate store checkout open at the start.

arrangements.text: The sender details sit above the chat messages, with request controls below the conversation.
The sender details sit beside the chat messages, with request controls beneath the purchasing request.

scenarios.name: callback
scenarios.screen: A support request shows the case reference, the requester's contact details, and controls for handling the request. No call has been made and no remote access has been allowed.
never: A call already connected.
A remote-access session open.
The support request already completed.

arrangements.text: The case reference sits above the request details, with handling controls below them.
The case reference and contact details sit beside the request text, with handling controls beneath the text.

scenarios.name: invoice
scenarios.screen: An invoice for one case shows its amount and bank details beside the vendor-master record, with a payment decision control. The invoice is unpaid and no decision has been made.
never: The invoice already paid.
A real payment confirmation.
A bank account picker open at the start.

arrangements.text: The invoice details sit to the left of the vendor-master record, with the payment control below the comparison.
The invoice details sit above the vendor-master record, with the payment control beneath both sets of details.
